name: Gante Lowd
source:
[i]"If you do decide to become our boss, I swear to protect you with my life." [/i]

[i]Avenger in Faith[/i]

A mafioso true and true who was adopted and raised by the original Liu family.

He works as a priest in a church in Taozhe, with hopes to one day rebuild the Liu family. 

[From [url=https://products.voltage.co.jp/neonclash/english/characters/]Voltage Inc.[/url]]
